title: Model
text: Reference another model to create model hierarchy, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Simulation mode} sets Simulation mode for model reference; {Model name} sets the file name of referenced model, {Code interface} sets the option to generate code from top model or referenced model Model, {Show model initialize port} sets the option to display initialize event port, {Show model reinitialize ports} sets the option to display reinitialize event ports, {Show model reset ports} sets the option to display reset event ports, {Show model terminate port} sets the option to display terminate event port, {Schedule rates} sets the option to schedule periodic events, {Schedule rates with} sets the option to create partitions or periodic event ports, {Instance parameters} displays instance parameters and specify values for referenced model, {Use local solver} sets the option to use local solver to solve referenced model link to referenced model configuration, {Solver} sets the option to select local solver link to referenced model configuration, {Fixed step} sets the option to specify step size for fixed-step local solver link to referenced model configuration, {Communication step size} sets the discrete interval of communication between local solver and parent solver positive scalar, {Input signal handling} sets the extrapolation method for local solver and {Output signal handling} sets the interpolation method for outputs from local. Values come from the instance.
